outcome: labor within 24 h after second device placement
cohort: Women with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation who required second-line cervical ripening at term due to a persistent unfavorable cervix after a first dinoprostone vaginal insert.
finding: Vaginal delivery rate and neonatal morbidity were similar between dinoprostone vaginal insert and cervical ripening balloon as a second line of cervical ripening, though CRB was more efficient in achieving a favorable cervix.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal deliveries was similar between the repeated dinoprostone vaginal insert and cervical ripening balloon groups.
